items.title: Marty Sheller interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 9, 2022
items.q: I did one arrangement on that album... but Bob, Robert Mercy did all the rest.

ctx.x: I think I read something about when Mongo’s band got signed to Columbia, that Mitch Miller assigned a producer that didn’t quite get it.

Yes. He assigned a fellow by the way who is a terrific musician named Robert Mercy who wrote for Andy Williams and other artists, I mean a really good musician. But to give him the job of producing a Mongo album, we all were like what? You know and sure enough he chose material that was not typically Mongo material and tried to make it into something commercial and it just, as far as we were concerned, it just didn’t work. I’m trying to think of the name of the song, I can’t think of it, but [scats]
